title: Reading a segment value
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers such that $\mu(a+j)$ equals the integer represented by $l_j$ for every $j<|l|$. For each $i<|l|$, $\mu(a+i)$ equals the integer represented by the $i$th entry of $l$.
